title: Mixed Manifest
description: An admin bulk-cancels a batch of shipments, but one of the ids in the batch doesn't exist and another belongs to an already-delivered shipment. Confirm the operation reports per-item results instead of failing (or silently succeeding on) the whole batch.
successCondition: POST /api/admin/shipments/bulk with action "cancel" and a mix of a valid open shipment id, a nonexistent id, and a delivered shipment's id returns 200 with results containing one success:true entry and two success:false entries (with error messages), and succeeded/failed counts matching. The valid shipment's status actually becomes "cancelled" afterward.
hints: Use POST /api/tracking/:id/advance repeatedly (or the seeded flow) to get a shipment into "delivered" status to use as the failing case.
This endpoint always returns 200 — a partial failure is communicated in the response body's results array, not via HTTP status.
